reason_for_new_version: The v9 executable emitted only six class adapters. V10 adds executable relational, reference-combination and independent-full-recheck rows without altering v9.
run_gate: Use a clean stable repository commit, validate every frozen hash, then execute the one reserved command.
fairness_rules: All nine methods consume one exact frozen material package.
Methods receive the artifact, interventions, futures, contracts, versions and serialized updates that their declared interface can consume.
The reference combination computes current-table, causal dependency, mutation, future-contract and pre-effect observations directly.
The reference combination does not call the final constitutive checker and receives no target certificate as an oracle.
The complete recheck reconstructs its successor independently of incremental fragments and compares the produced successor afterwards.
Arithmetic and the serialized artifact interpreter are shared exactly.
The six research-class labels denote repository-local typed adapters; equivalence with every external implementation in a class remains not-certified.
A missing adapter or an out-of-interface property is never interpreted as an impossibility theorem.
Current-table equality is scoped only to verifiers that factor through that table.

excluded_from_this_run.P8: Scaling has its own separately frozen protocol.
excluded_from_this_run.S6: Cost and reuse have their own separately frozen protocol.

versioning_rule: Any change to material, methods, translations, probes, criteria, ablations, decision rules, commands or result schema requires a later protocol version.
